# Template: Decision record

This is a reusable template, not an approved decision. Follow the [decision guidance](../decisions/README.md) before creating a record.

## Identity and evidence

Record the unique `DEC-*` identifier, descriptive title, date, business or technical kind, proposed/approved/rejected/superseded status, release scope, responsible capability, and approval evidence if applicable.

## Problem

Explain the ambiguity or conflict, affected users, current canonical behavior, and why a choice is needed.

## Options

Present the practical alternatives and their implications for simplicity, local liquidity, safety, friction, measurement, and future monetization.

## Recommendation or approved choice

State one precise recommendation or authorized choice and explain its rationale. Do not label a recommendation approved without evidence.

## Effective timing and existing resources

Specify when the policy applies, how existing requests/offers/contacts/entitlements are treated, and whether historical metrics require a traceable correction. Record reversibility and supersession behavior where relevant.

## Impact

List affected canonical paths, document identities, invariants, transitions, permissions, events, metrics, edge cases, and acceptance scenarios. Avoid storing a second full copy of the business specification.

## Verification and follow-through

Define observable acceptance expectations, documentation updates, implementation checks when applicable, unresolved questions, and the next action. Record the actual checks after completion and link any successor decision.
